messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api queue growth detected in us-east-1. p95/ p99 latency climbing; GPU pool approaching capacity (90%+) across multiple tenants. Autoscaler errors observed. tagging #oncall and #incidents :rotating_light:
Alice M: seeing a sharp spike in request rate around 13:02 UTC, largely from multiple small tenants (webhooks + embeddings). p99 for generation routes ~24s.
Ben R: confirmed. dashboards show continuous enqueue, provisioner creating pods but nodes in Pending due to cloud quota on GPUs. autoscaler-bot reports 'quota_limit' failures.
Carlos (infra): grabbing cloud account console now. if quota is the blocker we can request emergency quota, but ETA for new nodes might be 20-40m.
Dana SRE: immediate mitigations: 1) enable tenant-level soft rate-limits for high-churn tenants; 2) enable cheaper/quantized model fallback for non-SLA traffic; 3) enable prefix caching aggressor for repeated bursts. who can flip rate-limits?
Alice M: I can push a temporary limit rule. plan: throttle tenants with >200 req/s and route them to queued mode with 100ms backoff. doing in 2m.
Emma PM: flagging customers with in-app errors — CS to message top 3 customers after we stabilize. Impact: intermittent timeouts, degraded throughput.
Ben R: autoscaler-bot logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-15T13:04:10Z] provisioner: request_gpus=40 available_quota=8 -> failed: quota_exceeded
[2026-03-15T13:04:12Z] autoscaler: attempting_retry_count=3
[2026-03-15T13:04:25Z] nodepool: create_node failed: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
```
Carlos (infra): opened provider ticket INC-78122 for emergency quota bump. support ETA 30-45m. also noticed us-west spare capacity but cross-region routing disabled for these tenants by default.
Dana SRE: Ben/Alice - go ahead with tenant throttles + model fallback. I'll enable cross-region routing for low-priority traffic to us-west as an emergency measure if CS ok.
Alice M: applied temp rate-limits for five noisy tenants: config snippet:
```
route_rules:
  - match: tenant in (t-435,t-512,t-77)
    action: soft_throttle
    limit: 150rps
    mode: queued
```
Applied at 13:07 UTC.
Ben R: enabling quantized fallback for non-SLA routes now (`/config/rollout enable quant-fallback --tag=non-sla`). change pushed at 13:09 UTC.
autoscaler-bot: Fallback policy applied for model groups: gptx-small-quant. Expected per-token cost reduction ~2.5x; latency trade-off minimal for short completions.
Alice M: p95 dropped from 24s -> 9s for affected routes after throttles + fallback. overall queue length trending down but still elevated for embedding-heavy tenants.
Customer Support: CS is drafting outbound to top 3 impacted customers. will include ETA and mitigation summary.
Dana SRE: still seeing stuck requests with status=waiting-for-gpu (old enqueued items). running drain-cleanup to clear retries for timed-out jobs. cmd: `enqueue-clean --older-than=6s --dry-run` then `enqueue-clean --confirm`.
Ben R: executed cleanup at 13:18 UTC. reclaimed ~120 worker slots. queue length reduced ~18%.
Carlos (infra): provider responded to ticket: provisional quota bump to 32 GPUs for 1 hour while they process full request. manual approval required. I'm requesting immediate grant now.
Emma PM: what's our rollback plan if quota denied? we should prioritize high-value customers and keep public endpoints degraded but available.
Dana SRE: agreed. next steps: 1) if quota denied, enable strict rate-limits for non-paying tenants and move some background jobs to delayed window; 2) open emergency sales/CS briefing for top customers.
Alice M: adding routing policy to bias traffic to dedicated-pool for tenants with enterprise flag: `route_priority += dedicated_if_enterprise`. pushing now.
autoscaler-bot: provider granted provisional increase to 32 GPUs at 13:29 UTC. nodes being provisioned.
Ben R: provisioning succeeded for 6 nodes at 13:34 UTC. autoscaler catch-up is in progress, KV caches warming.
Alice M: monitoring p99 — still a few spikes caused by large embeddings requests. proposing temporary embedding size cap for shared-hosted: max_tokens=4096 for non-enterprise. anyone opposed?
Carlos (infra): OK to enforce. I'll add the policy and publish a note to docs later.
Customer Support: CS message sent to impacted accounts at 13:37 UTC. included workaround and expected resolution window (45-60m).
Dana SRE: We're at steady-state: p95 ~600ms, p99 ~1.8s for most routes. queue length decreasing. leaving soft throttles in place for 30m.
Emma PM: log action items: quota follow-up, post-incident summary, update runbook to include cross-region emergency routing steps. assign owners?
Alice M: I'll own runbook update. Ben take cloud quota postmortem. Dana will own cleanup tooling improvements. Carlos will follow provider ticket until permanent quota applied. Emma will coordinate customer comms.
Ben R: noted. opening postmortem ticket PM-1402.
Dana SRE: preparing handoff to night oncall in 40m. leaving clear checklist: current mitigations, provider ticket id INC-78122, list of throttled tenants, commands to revert rate-limits.
Alice M: handoff note -> next oncall @Ben R (night): TTL 40m. summary: elevated queue due to cross-tenant burst + provider quota limits -> mitigated via tenant throttles, model fallbacks, emergency quota grant.
Ben R: taking handoff. will stay on until queue normalizes or quota fully applied.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: sev2 -> downgraded at 13:45 UTC. oncall: Ben R -> handoff planned at 14:25 UTC.
Emma PM: thanks everyone. postmortem draft requested within 24h. :thumbsup:
